name: SWOT 分析
definition: 识别组织或项目的内部优势（Strengths）、劣势（Weaknesses），以及外部机会（Opportunities）、威胁（Threats）的战略规划工具。
essence: 核心在于“内外兼修”，同时审视内部可控因素和外部不可控因素。具有强烈的战略导向和高度的灵活性，支持动态调整。

scenarios.title: 战略规划
scenarios.text: 一家科技初创公司在进入新市场前，使用SWOT分析评估其技术优势、资金劣势、市场增长机会和现有巨头竞争威胁，从而制定差异化进入策略。

scenarios.title: 问题解决
scenarios.text: 某零售连锁店面临销售下滑，通过SWOT分析发现内部服务质量下降（劣势），但线上销售平台发展迅速（机会），从而决定投资员工培训并加速电商转型。

scenarios.title: 可行性研究
scenarios.text: 某制造企业在原材料价格大幅上涨时，进行SWOT分析，识别自身库存管理优势、对单一供应商的依赖、市场需求弹性以及国际贸易政策变化，以制定采购和生产调整方案。

pros: 框架简单易懂，易于应用。
提供全面的内部和外部视角。
有助于团队进行坦诚评估和讨论。
帮助识别优势与机会的匹配策略。
cons: 分析结果可能具有静态性。
因素识别和分类可能存在主观偏见。
仅提供现状分析，不直接提供解决方案。
可能过度强调外部因素，导致被动战略。
analysis: 尽管SWOT分析因其“静态性”而受批评，但其效用并非一次性，应融入持续的战略审查周期。为克服主观性，应鼓励多元化团队参与。它是一个诊断工具而非治疗工具，需结合其他工具（如CBA、决策树）将洞察转化为行动。
definition_en: A strategic planning tool for identifying an organization or project's internal Strengths and Weaknesses, as well as external Opportunities and Threats.
essence_en: Its core is to look both inward and outward at the same time, examining internal factors you can control alongside external factors you cannot. It has a strong strategic orientation and a high degree of flexibility, and it supports dynamic adjustment.

scenarios_en.title: Strategic Planning
scenarios_en.text: Before entering a new market, a tech startup uses SWOT analysis to assess its technological strengths, funding weaknesses, market growth opportunities, and the competitive threat from existing giants, and then develops a differentiated market-entry strategy.

scenarios_en.title: Problem Solving
scenarios_en.text: Faced with declining sales, a retail chain uses SWOT analysis to discover declining internal service quality (a weakness) but rapid growth in online sales platforms (an opportunity), and therefore decides to invest in staff training and accelerate its e-commerce transformation.

scenarios_en.title: Feasibility Study
scenarios_en.text: When raw material prices rise sharply, a manufacturing company conducts a SWOT analysis to identify its inventory management strengths, its dependence on a single supplier, market demand elasticity, and changes in international trade policy, in order to develop procurement and production adjustment plans.

pros_en: The framework is simple, easy to understand, and easy to apply.
It provides a comprehensive view of both internal and external factors.
It helps teams carry out candid assessments and discussions.
It helps identify strategies that match strengths with opportunities.
cons_en: The results of the analysis can be static.
Identifying and classifying factors can be subject to subjective bias.
It only provides an analysis of the current situation and does not directly offer solutions.
It may overemphasize external factors, leading to a passive strategy.
analysis_en: Although SWOT analysis is criticized for being static, it is not meant to be a one-off exercise; it should be built into an ongoing cycle of strategic review. To overcome subjectivity, encourage diverse teams to take part. It is a diagnostic tool, not a cure, and needs to be combined with other tools (such as CBA and decision trees) to turn insights into action.

name: 决策树
definition: 一种层级树状结构，通过一系列“是/否”问题逐步缩小可能性，最终得出决策或预测。
essence: 核心在于其层级结构和“分而治之”的策略。通过贪婪搜索识别最优分割点，递归地将数据划分为同质子集。其运作方式模仿人类思维，易于理解。常通过剪枝或随机森林等方法提高准确性。

scenarios.title: 风险评估
scenarios.text: 银行使用决策树评估贷款申请人的信用风险，根据收入、负债、还款历史等特征，预测违约可能性。

scenarios.title: 战略规划
scenarios.text: 零售商使用决策树决定是否进入新市场，评估市场规模、竞争强度、投资成本和预期回报等因素。

scenarios.title: 客户细分与诊断
scenarios.text: 医生利用决策树根据患者症状（如发烧、咳嗽）来诊断疾病，逐步缩小可能性，直至得出最可能的诊断。

pros: 布尔逻辑和可视化结构使其易于解释和理解。
对数据准备要求较低，能处理离散、连续数据和缺失值。
灵活性高，适用于分类和回归任务。
cons: 复杂的决策树容易过拟合，泛化能力差。
数据微小变化可能导致结构剧变，表现出高方差。
训练成本相对较高。
analysis: 其“易解释性”是超越其他复杂算法的关键管理优势，能促进信任和执行。剪枝原则与管理中追求简洁高效的原则不谋而合。在“客户细分”中的应用，将其从纯粹的分析工具提升为驱动业务增长的战略工具。
definition_en: A hierarchical tree structure that progressively narrows the possibilities through a series of yes/no questions, ultimately arriving at a decision or prediction.
essence_en: Its core lies in its hierarchical structure and divide-and-conquer strategy. Through a greedy search, it identifies the optimal split points and recursively divides data into homogeneous subsets. It works in a way that mimics human thinking and is easy to understand. Accuracy is often improved through methods such as pruning or random forests.

scenarios_en.title: Risk Assessment
scenarios_en.text: Banks use decision trees to assess the credit risk of loan applicants, predicting the likelihood of default based on characteristics such as income, debt, and repayment history.

scenarios_en.title: Strategic Planning
scenarios_en.text: A retailer uses a decision tree to decide whether to enter a new market, evaluating factors such as market size, competitive intensity, investment cost, and expected return.

scenarios_en.title: Customer Segmentation and Diagnosis
scenarios_en.text: Doctors use decision trees to diagnose illness based on a patient's symptoms (such as fever and cough), progressively narrowing the possibilities until they reach the most likely diagnosis.

pros_en: Its Boolean logic and visual structure make it easy to explain and understand.
It places relatively low demands on data preparation and can handle discrete and continuous data as well as missing values.
It is highly flexible and suitable for both classification and regression tasks.
cons_en: Complex decision trees are prone to overfitting and generalize poorly.
Small changes in the data can cause dramatic changes in structure, showing high variance.
Training costs are relatively high.
analysis_en: Its interpretability is a key managerial advantage over other, more complex algorithms, because it fosters trust and execution. The principle of pruning aligns neatly with management's pursuit of simplicity and efficiency. Its use in customer segmentation elevates it from a purely analytical tool to a strategic tool that drives business growth.

name: 成本效益分析 (CBA)
definition: 比较项目或决策的总成本和总效益，通过赋予货币价值来判断其可行性和盈利能力。
essence: 核心在于将所有成本和效益（包括有形和无形）转化为共同的货币价值进行比较。关注BCR、NPV、ROI等核心指标，并进行敏感性分析。

scenarios.title: 新产品开发
scenarios.text: 微软在开发Surface系列产品时，进行CBA来权衡开发和营销成本与预计收入。

scenarios.title: 项目投资决策
scenarios.text: 某公司考虑投资新生产线，通过CBA评估设备采购、运营成本与预期产量增加、质量提升带来的收益。

scenarios.title: 医疗保健决策
scenarios.text: 医院评估引入电子健康记录（EHR）系统的成本与改善患者数据管理和健康结果的效益。

pros: 依赖事实数据而非直觉，确保知情决策。
尝试量化无形因素，如客户满意度。
提供清晰框架，提高资源分配效率。
强制全面考虑，揭示隐藏成本和效益。
cons: 难以精确估值无形因素，可能导致遗漏。
存在高估效益或低估成本的潜在偏见。
收集数据可能耗时且成本高昂。
长期项目预测准确性较低。
analysis: 对“无形效益”的量化尝试反映了现代管理对非财务价值的重视。其“敏感性分析”是应对未来不确定性的重要风险管理机制。其“时间局限性”提示管理者需结合情景规划等长期战略工具使用。
definition_en: Comparing the total costs and total benefits of a project or decision, assigning them monetary values to judge its feasibility and profitability.
essence_en: Its core is to convert all costs and benefits (including tangible and intangible ones) into a common monetary value for comparison. It focuses on core metrics such as BCR, NPV, and ROI, and includes sensitivity analysis.

scenarios_en.title: New Product Development
scenarios_en.text: When developing the Surface product line, Microsoft carried out a CBA to weigh development and marketing costs against projected revenue.

scenarios_en.title: Project Investment Decision
scenarios_en.text: A company considering investment in a new production line uses CBA to assess equipment procurement and operating costs against the benefits of increased expected output and improved quality.

scenarios_en.title: Healthcare Decision-Making
scenarios_en.text: A hospital evaluates the costs of introducing an electronic health record (EHR) system against the benefits of improved patient data management and health outcomes.

pros_en: It relies on factual data rather than intuition, ensuring informed decisions.
It attempts to quantify intangible factors, such as customer satisfaction.
It provides a clear framework and improves the efficiency of resource allocation.
It forces comprehensive consideration, revealing hidden costs and benefits.
cons_en: Intangible factors are difficult to value precisely, which can lead to omissions.
There is a potential bias toward overstating benefits or understating costs.
Collecting data can be time-consuming and costly.
Forecasts for long-term projects are less accurate.
analysis_en: The attempt to quantify intangible benefits reflects modern management's emphasis on non-financial value. Its sensitivity analysis is an important risk management mechanism for dealing with future uncertainty. Its time limitations suggest that managers should use it together with long-term strategic tools such as scenario planning.

name: 头脑风暴
definition: 通过自由分享和建立想法，在无评判环境中产生大量新想法和解决方案。
essence: 核心原则是“禁止批判”，鼓励在他人想法基础上联想和发展，通过结合不同视角产生创新方案。

scenarios.title: 问题解决
scenarios.text: 软件开发团队在遇到一个顽固的bug时，进行头脑风暴，集思广益寻找可能的修复方案。

scenarios.title: 新产品开发
scenarios.text: 某快消品公司为推出新零食，组织头脑风暴，征集产品名称、包装设计和广告语。

scenarios.title: 团队建设
scenarios.text: 项目启动会上，团队成员通过头脑风暴共同确定项目目标、挑战和初步方案，增强参与感。

pros: 激发创造力，产生创新想法。
增强团队合作和凝聚力。
能在短时间内收集大量多元化想法。
汇集不同背景和经验的观点。
cons: 强势个体可能主导讨论，压制内向者想法。
可能存在锚定效应，过度关注最初想法。
可能产生大量不切实际的想法。
早期禁止批判可能阻碍优质想法的形成。
analysis: “禁止批判”与“批判性思维”之间存在张力，暗示了创新需要区分“发散”和“收敛”两个阶段。为解决“偏袒善于表达者”的问题，管理者需运用脑力写作等技巧。为打破“锚定效应”，可引入随机词汇、角色扮演等方法。
definition_en: Generating a large number of new ideas and solutions by freely sharing and building on ideas in an environment free of judgment.
essence_en: Its core principle is to prohibit criticism, encouraging people to associate and build on others' ideas, and to produce innovative solutions by combining different perspectives.

scenarios_en.title: Problem Solving
scenarios_en.text: When a software development team encounters a stubborn bug, it brainstorms to pool ideas for possible fixes.

scenarios_en.title: New Product Development
scenarios_en.text: To launch a new snack, a consumer goods company organizes a brainstorming session to gather ideas for product names, packaging designs, and advertising slogans.

scenarios_en.title: Team Building
scenarios_en.text: At a project kickoff meeting, team members use brainstorming to jointly define project goals, challenges, and initial solutions, strengthening their sense of involvement.

pros_en: It sparks creativity and generates innovative ideas.
It strengthens teamwork and cohesion.
It can gather a large number of diverse ideas in a short time.
It brings together viewpoints from different backgrounds and experience.
cons_en: Dominant individuals may take over the discussion and suppress the ideas of more introverted participants.
An anchoring effect may occur, with excessive focus on the initial ideas.
It may produce a large number of impractical ideas.
Prohibiting criticism early on may hinder the formation of high-quality ideas.
analysis_en: There is tension between prohibiting criticism and critical thinking, suggesting that innovation needs to distinguish between two stages: divergence and convergence. To solve the problem of favoring those who express themselves well, managers need to use techniques such as brainwriting. To break the anchoring effect, methods such as random words and role-playing can be introduced.

name: 德尔菲法
definition: 通过多轮匿名问卷调查，汇集专家意见并逐步达成共识，用于预测和决策。
essence: 核心在于“匿名性”以消除偏见和群体思维，“多轮迭代”和“受控反馈”逐步达成共识。成功依赖于“专家小组”的选择。

scenarios.title: 商业预测
scenarios.text: 科技公司使用德尔菲法预测未来5-10年人工智能技术的发展趋势和潜在应用。

scenarios.title: 长期战略制定
scenarios.text: 政府部门利用德尔菲法评估新政策选项的可行性、可取性和可能性，例如应对气候变化的长期策略。

scenarios.title: 风险评估
scenarios.text: 制药公司在开发新药时，通过德尔菲法汇集医学专家意见，评估药物的潜在副作用和市场接受度。

pros: 匿名性有效消除群体思维和个人影响力。
能整合来自不同背景的专家见解。
可远程进行，不受地理限制。
能有效利用专家经验处理定性信息。
迭代过程确保洞察得到彻底审查。
cons: 过程非常耗时。
匿名性限制了深入辩论和即时澄清。
结果质量高度依赖于所选专家。
共识不等于正确。
存在专家流失风险。
analysis: “匿名性”解决了群体决策中的“权力动态”问题。其“迭代轮次”体现了决策中“渐进式完善”的理念。在“数据稀缺”情境下，它为系统化利用专家经验这种“软数据”提供了有效途径。
definition_en: Gathering expert opinion through multiple rounds of anonymous questionnaires and gradually reaching consensus, for use in forecasting and decision-making.
essence_en: Its core lies in anonymity, to eliminate bias and groupthink, and in multiple rounds of iteration and controlled feedback to gradually reach consensus. Its success depends on the selection of the expert panel.

scenarios_en.title: Business Forecasting
scenarios_en.text: A technology company uses the Delphi method to forecast the development trends and potential applications of artificial intelligence technology over the next 5-10 years.

scenarios_en.title: Long-Term Strategy Formulation
scenarios_en.text: A government department uses the Delphi method to assess the feasibility, desirability, and likelihood of new policy options, such as long-term strategies for addressing climate change.

scenarios_en.title: Risk Assessment
scenarios_en.text: When developing a new drug, a pharmaceutical company uses the Delphi method to gather medical experts' opinions and assess the drug's potential side effects and market acceptance.

pros_en: Anonymity effectively eliminates groupthink and individual influence.
It can integrate expert insights from different backgrounds.
It can be conducted remotely, without geographic limitations.
It can effectively use expert experience to handle qualitative information.
The iterative process ensures insights are thoroughly examined.
cons_en: The process is very time-consuming.
Anonymity limits in-depth debate and immediate clarification.
The quality of the results depends heavily on the experts selected.
Consensus does not equal correctness.
There is a risk of expert attrition.
analysis_en: Anonymity solves the problem of power dynamics in group decision-making. Its iterative rounds embody the idea of progressive refinement in decision-making. In situations where data is scarce, it provides an effective way to systematically use expert experience - a form of soft data.

name: 帕累托分析
definition: 基于“80/20法则”，识别导致大部分结果的“关键的少数”因素。
essence: 核心是“80/20法则”，即原因与结果之间存在不平衡关系。旨在识别并集中精力解决产生最大影响的少数根源问题。结果常以帕累托图呈现。

scenarios.title: 质量改进
scenarios.text: 制造企业分析产品缺陷数据，发现80%的缺陷源于20%的生产流程问题，从而优先改进这些关键流程。

scenarios.title: 优先级排序
scenarios.text: 项目经理分析项目延误原因，发现80%的延误是由于20%的任务（如关键供应商延迟）造成的，从而优先解决这些瓶颈。

scenarios.title: 客户服务
scenarios.text: 客户服务团队分析投诉数据，发现80%的投诉集中在20%的产品功能上，从而建议产品团队优先改进这些功能。

pros: 帮助识别问题的根本原因。
引导精力集中于高影响行动，实现高效聚焦。
帕累托图直观展示问题优先级。
通过解决高优先级问题提高整体绩效。
cons: 仅识别问题原因，不提供解决方案。
只能基于过去数据，无法预测未来。
收集和分析数据可能耗时。
有时可能侧重于定性数据。
analysis: “80/20法则”揭示了管理中的“非线性回报”现象，挑战了“平均用力”的管理思维。其“仅识别问题”的特性，强调了它作为“诊断工具”而非“治疗工具”的定位。对“过去数据”的依赖，提示管理者需结合预测性工具（如情景规划）补充。
definition_en: Based on the 80/20 rule, identifying the vital few factors that produce most of the results.
essence_en: Its core is the 80/20 rule - that there is an imbalance between causes and results. It aims to identify and focus effort on the few root problems that have the greatest impact. Results are often presented as a Pareto chart.

scenarios_en.title: Quality Improvement
scenarios_en.text: A manufacturing company analyzes product defect data and finds that 80% of defects stem from 20% of production process problems, so it prioritizes improving those key processes.

scenarios_en.title: Prioritization
scenarios_en.text: A project manager analyzes the causes of project delays and finds that 80% of delays are caused by 20% of tasks (such as delays from a key supplier), so they prioritize resolving those bottlenecks.

scenarios_en.title: Customer Service
scenarios_en.text: A customer service team analyzes complaint data and finds that 80% of complaints are concentrated on 20% of product features, so it recommends that the product team prioritize improving those features.

pros_en: It helps identify the root causes of problems.
It directs effort toward high-impact actions, achieving efficient focus.
A Pareto chart visually shows problem priorities.
Solving high-priority problems improves overall performance.
cons_en: It only identifies the causes of problems; it does not provide solutions.
It can only be based on past data and cannot predict the future.
Collecting and analyzing data can be time-consuming.
It may at times focus on qualitative data.
analysis_en: The 80/20 rule reveals the phenomenon of non-linear returns in management, challenging the mindset of spreading effort evenly. Its characteristic of only identifying problems emphasizes its positioning as a diagnostic tool rather than a cure. Its reliance on past data suggests managers should supplement it with predictive tools (such as scenario planning).

name: 六顶思考帽
definition: 一种思维框架，帮助个人和团队从六个特定视角（帽子）进行决策和问题解决。
essence: 核心是“平行思维”，鼓励所有参与者同时从同一视角思考，避免对抗。六顶帽子分别代表：白（事实）、黄（效益）、黑（风险）、红（情感）、绿（创意）、蓝（控制）。

scenarios.title: 会议效率提升
scenarios.text: 团队在产品开发会上，按白、绿、黑、蓝帽顺序讨论，确保各方面都得到充分考虑。

scenarios.title: 问题解决与创新
scenarios.text: 公司面临员工流失问题，用六顶帽从事实、感受、风险、机会、积极影响等角度分析，制定综合方案。

scenarios.title: 冲突解决
scenarios.text: 两个部门因项目优先级分歧，通过六顶帽练习，双方被要求从对方的“帽子”角度思考，促进理解和共识。

pros: 增强协作与包容性，平衡团队参与。
减少偏见，提升决策的全面性和韧性。
结构化讨论，提高会议效率。
绿帽思维激发创造力。
红帽提供安全表达情感和直觉的渠道。
cons: 在团队中应用可能耗时。
不同视角间仍可能存在强烈分歧。
经验不足的用户可能混淆角色。
对如何解决冲突观点指导较少。
analysis: “平行思维”是克服群体决策中“对抗性思维”的有效策略。对“情感和直觉”的明确接纳，挑战了传统理性决策的局限性。其“耗时”特性提示管理者需在“效率”与“全面性”之间权衡。
definition_en: A thinking framework that helps individuals and teams make decisions and solve problems from six specific perspectives (hats).
essence_en: Its core is parallel thinking, encouraging all participants to think from the same perspective at the same time and avoiding confrontation. The six hats represent: White (facts), Yellow (benefits), Black (risks), Red (feelings), Green (creativity), and Blue (control).

scenarios_en.title: Improving Meeting Efficiency
scenarios_en.text: At a product development meeting, the team discusses in the order of the White, Green, Black, and Blue hats, ensuring every aspect is fully considered.

scenarios_en.title: Problem Solving and Innovation
scenarios_en.text: Faced with an employee turnover problem, a company uses the Six Hats to analyze it from the angles of facts, feelings, risks, opportunities, and positive impacts, and develops a comprehensive plan.

scenarios_en.title: Conflict Resolution
scenarios_en.text: When two departments disagree over project priorities, a Six Hats exercise requires both sides to think from the other side's hat perspective, promoting understanding and consensus.

pros_en: It enhances collaboration and inclusiveness and balances team participation.
It reduces bias and improves the comprehensiveness and resilience of decisions.
It structures discussion and improves meeting efficiency.
Green Hat thinking sparks creativity.
The Red Hat provides a safe channel for expressing feelings and intuition.
cons_en: Applying it in a team can be time-consuming.
Strong disagreements may still exist between different perspectives.
Inexperienced users may confuse the roles.
It offers relatively little guidance on how to resolve conflicting viewpoints.
analysis_en: Parallel thinking is an effective strategy for overcoming adversarial thinking in group decision-making. Its explicit acceptance of feelings and intuition challenges the limitations of traditional rational decision-making. Its time-consuming nature suggests managers need to weigh efficiency against comprehensiveness.

name: AHP (层次分析法)
definition: 通过成对比较，将复杂决策分解为目标、准则和备选方案的层级结构，对方案进行排序。
essence: 将复杂决策分解为层级结构。核心方法是对准则和方案进行“成对比较”，使用1-9标度表示偏好强度，最终计算出总分并排序。

scenarios.title: 供应商选择
scenarios.text: 制造企业使用AHP对成本、交货时间、质量认证等准则进行加权，并对不同供应商进行成对比较，选出最佳供应商。

scenarios.title: 项目优先级排序
scenarios.text: 研发部门利用AHP对多个创新项目的市场潜力、技术可行性、所需资源等准则进行评估和排序。

scenarios.title: 人事招聘
scenarios.text: 企业招聘高管时，通过AHP对候选人的领导力、行业经验、团队协作能力等因素进行加权评估。

pros: 为复杂决策提供系统化和逻辑化的组织方法。
能将准则重要性和方案表现进行量化。
构建层级结构的过程帮助决策者增进理解。
可通过软件实现，易于实施。
cons: 1-9标度的选择具有任意性，含义模糊。
当准则或方案较多时，易出现偏好不一致性。
引入新方案可能改变现有方案排名（秩次逆转）。
在比率尺度上表达偏好存在认知困难。
analysis: “成对比较”机制是应对人类“有限理性”的尝试，降低了认知负担。“秩次逆转”问题揭示了其在动态决策环境中的脆弱性。“认知困难”强调了用户培训和软件辅助的重要性。
definition_en: Through pairwise comparisons, decomposing a complex decision into a hierarchy of goals, criteria, and alternatives, and ranking the alternatives.
essence_en: It decomposes a complex decision into a hierarchical structure. Its core method is to carry out pairwise comparisons of criteria and alternatives, using a 1-9 scale to express the strength of preference, and ultimately calculate total scores and rank them.

scenarios_en.title: Supplier Selection
scenarios_en.text: A manufacturing company uses AHP to weight criteria such as cost, delivery time, and quality certification, and carries out pairwise comparisons of different suppliers to select the best one.

scenarios_en.title: Project Prioritization
scenarios_en.text: An R&D department uses AHP to evaluate and rank multiple innovation projects on criteria such as market potential, technical feasibility, and resources required.

scenarios_en.title: Personnel Recruitment
scenarios_en.text: When recruiting executives, a company uses AHP to carry out a weighted assessment of candidates' leadership, industry experience, teamwork ability, and other factors.

pros_en: It provides a systematic and logical way to organize complex decisions.
It can quantify the importance of criteria and the performance of alternatives.
The process of building the hierarchy helps decision-makers deepen their understanding.
It can be implemented through software and is easy to carry out.
cons_en: The choice of the 1-9 scale is arbitrary and its meaning is ambiguous.
When there are many criteria or alternatives, preference inconsistency can easily arise.
Introducing a new alternative may change the ranking of existing alternatives (rank reversal).
Expressing preferences on a ratio scale presents cognitive difficulties.
analysis_en: The pairwise comparison mechanism is an attempt to cope with human bounded rationality, reducing cognitive burden. The rank reversal problem reveals its fragility in dynamic decision environments. The cognitive difficulties emphasize the importance of user training and software support.

name: 加权决策矩阵
definition: 对多个选项根据一组按重要性加权的准则进行比较和评估，选择最佳方案。
essence: 核心在于“权重分配”，每个评估准则被赋予不同权重。通过“评分与计算”得出每个选项的总加权分数。旨在实现更客观理性的决策。

scenarios.title: 项目选择
scenarios.text: 公司评估多个新产品开发项目在市场潜力、技术可行性、开发成本等方面的表现，并根据战略优先级赋权，选择投资组合。

scenarios.title: 解决方案选择
scenarios.text: 采购部门选择新的CRM系统，对成本、功能性、易用性、客户支持等准则进行加权，并对候选系统评分。

scenarios.title: 招聘决策
scenarios.text: 人力资源部门对候选人的技术能力、软技能、文化契合度等因素进行加权评估，确保招聘到最匹配的人才。

pros: 通过权重分配减少个人偏见和主观性。
能对多个选项进行全面细致的评估。
决策过程透明，便于利益相关者理解。
结构化过程确保评估的一致性。
cons: 准则权重分配仍有主观性。
结论可靠性取决于评估数据的准确性。
当选项、准则和数据量大时，可能耗时且复杂。
analysis: 其“透明度”是提升组织内部“决策信任”的关键。“权重分配”过程是团队“价值对齐”的机会。“数据准确性依赖”反向推动了组织对数据治理和信息质量的重视。
definition_en: Comparing and evaluating multiple options against a set of criteria weighted by importance, in order to select the best solution.
essence_en: Its core lies in weight allocation, with each evaluation criterion given a different weight. Total weighted scores for each option are derived through scoring and calculation. It aims to achieve more objective and rational decisions.

scenarios_en.title: Project Selection
scenarios_en.text: A company evaluates multiple new product development projects on market potential, technical feasibility, development cost, and other aspects, assigns weights according to strategic priorities, and selects an investment portfolio.

scenarios_en.title: Solution Selection
scenarios_en.text: A procurement department selecting a new CRM system weights criteria such as cost, functionality, ease of use, and customer support, and scores the candidate systems.

scenarios_en.title: Recruitment Decision
scenarios_en.text: A human resources department carries out a weighted assessment of candidates' technical ability, soft skills, cultural fit, and other factors to ensure it hires the best-matching talent.

pros_en: Weight allocation reduces personal bias and subjectivity.
It allows a comprehensive and detailed evaluation of multiple options.
The decision process is transparent and easy for stakeholders to understand.
The structured process ensures consistency in evaluation.
cons_en: The allocation of criterion weights still involves subjectivity.
The reliability of the conclusions depends on the accuracy of the evaluation data.
When there are many options, criteria, and data, it can be time-consuming and complex.
analysis_en: Its transparency is key to improving decision trust within an organization. The weight allocation process is an opportunity for the team to achieve value alignment. Its dependence on data accuracy in turn drives the organization's attention to data governance and information quality.

name: 优缺点列表
definition: 列出特定决策或行动的所有优点（Pros）和缺点（Cons），帮助理解问题的两面。
essence: 核心在于其“双面性”和“可视化”呈现。旨在通过列出所有相关因素来减少不确定性并促进“客观性”。也可以为每个优缺点分配权重。

scenarios.title: 个人决策
scenarios.text: 个人在考虑是否接受一份新工作时，列出新工作的薪资福利、职业发展机会（优点）与通勤时间、工作压力（缺点）。

scenarios.title: 简单业务决策
scenarios.text: 小型企业选择是否采用新的云存储服务时，列出其成本节约、易用性（优点）与数据迁移风险、供应商锁定（缺点）。

scenarios.title: 项目风险初步评估
scenarios.text: 产品经理评估是否添加某个新功能时，列出其用户增长（优点）与开发成本、维护复杂性（缺点）。

pros: 简单易用，易于理解和操作。
帮助理清思路，直观展示潜在影响。
降低做出仓促或非理性决策的风险。
可能揭示需要进一步研究的知识空白。
有助于客观决策，促进透明度。
cons: 不建立不同优缺点的相对重要性。
可能过度简化复杂决策。
可能忽略重要细节，导致信息不完整。
可能存在个人偏见。
过于依赖可能抑制创造性和直觉。
analysis: 其“简单性”是广泛应用的基础，但也限制了其在复杂决策中的深度。“无法量化重要性”的问题，促使管理者向“加权”思维升级。“揭示知识空白”的能力，强调了决策前信息收集的持续性。
definition_en: Listing all the advantages (Pros) and disadvantages (Cons) of a particular decision or action to help understand both sides of an issue.
essence_en: Its core lies in its two-sided nature and visual presentation. It aims to reduce uncertainty and promote objectivity by listing all relevant factors. Weights can also be assigned to each pro and con.

scenarios_en.title: Personal Decision
scenarios_en.text: When considering whether to accept a new job, an individual lists the new job's salary and benefits and career development opportunities (pros) against commuting time and work pressure (cons).

scenarios_en.title: Simple Business Decision
scenarios_en.text: When a small business chooses whether to adopt a new cloud storage service, it lists its cost savings and ease of use (pros) against data migration risks and vendor lock-in (cons).

scenarios_en.title: Preliminary Project Risk Assessment
scenarios_en.text: When a product manager evaluates whether to add a new feature, they list its user growth (pros) against development cost and maintenance complexity (cons).

pros_en: It is simple and easy to use, and easy to understand and operate.
It helps clarify thinking and visually shows potential impacts.
It reduces the risk of making hasty or irrational decisions.
It may reveal knowledge gaps that need further research.
It helps with objective decision-making and promotes transparency.
cons_en: It does not establish the relative importance of different pros and cons.
It may oversimplify complex decisions.
It may overlook important details, leading to incomplete information.
Personal bias may be present.
Over-reliance on it may suppress creativity and intuition.
analysis_en: Its simplicity is the basis for its wide application, but it also limits its depth in complex decisions. The problem of being unable to quantify importance prompts managers to upgrade to weighted thinking. Its ability to reveal knowledge gaps emphasizes the continuity of information gathering before a decision.

name: 波特五力分析
definition: 分析行业竞争强度和吸引力，评估五种竞争力量：现有竞争者、供应商、买方、替代品和新进入者。
essence: 独特之处在于其“超越直接竞争”的视角，考虑整个价值链的竞争力量。帮助企业判断行业吸引力并定位以获得竞争优势。

scenarios.title: 市场进入策略
scenarios.text: 一家软件公司考虑进入在线教育行业，通过五力分析评估现有竞争者、替代学习方式的威胁等。

scenarios.title: 竞争战略调整
scenarios.text: 传统媒体公司通过五力分析识别来自社交媒体的替代威胁，从而调整战略，加强数字内容投入。

scenarios.title: 投资评估
scenarios.text: 投资机构在投资电池制造商时，运用五力分析评估电池行业的竞争格局、原材料供应商议价能力等。

pros: 提供全面的行业竞争格局分析。
提供战略规划指导，帮助识别竞争优势。
支持市场投资规划和研发预算。
提供长期洞察，帮助规避风险。
cons: 对业务伙伴等利益相关者关注不足。
分析可能导致过于悲观的结论。
对快速变化的数字市场可能不太适用。
是一个特定时间点的快照，具有静态性。
analysis: “超越直接竞争”原则揭示了“生态系统思维”的重要性。其“静态性”强调了持续监控和灵活调整的必要性。“可能过于悲观”的特性，提示管理者需结合内部能力评估（如SWOT）。
definition_en: Analyzing the intensity of competition and attractiveness of an industry by assessing five competitive forces: existing competitors, suppliers, buyers, substitutes, and new entrants.
essence_en: Its distinctive feature is its perspective of looking beyond direct competition, considering competitive forces across the entire value chain. It helps companies judge an industry's attractiveness and position themselves to gain a competitive advantage.

scenarios_en.title: Market Entry Strategy
scenarios_en.text: A software company considering entering the online education industry uses Five Forces analysis to assess existing competitors, the threat of alternative learning methods, and so on.

scenarios_en.title: Competitive Strategy Adjustment
scenarios_en.text: A traditional media company uses Five Forces analysis to identify the substitute threat from social media, and therefore adjusts its strategy and increases investment in digital content.

scenarios_en.title: Investment Evaluation
scenarios_en.text: When investing in a battery manufacturer, an investment institution uses Five Forces analysis to assess the competitive landscape of the battery industry, the bargaining power of raw material suppliers, and so on.

pros_en: It provides a comprehensive analysis of an industry's competitive landscape.
It provides guidance for strategic planning and helps identify competitive advantages.
It supports market investment planning and R&D budgets.
It provides long-term insights and helps avoid risks.
cons_en: It pays insufficient attention to stakeholders such as business partners.
The analysis may lead to overly pessimistic conclusions.
It may be less applicable to rapidly changing digital markets.
It is a snapshot at a specific point in time and is static in nature.
analysis_en: The principle of looking beyond direct competition reveals the importance of ecosystem thinking. Its static nature emphasizes the need for continuous monitoring and flexible adjustment. Its tendency to be overly pessimistic suggests managers should combine it with an assessment of internal capabilities (such as SWOT).

name: PESTLE 分析
definition: 评估影响企业的外部宏观环境因素：政治、经济、社会、技术、法律和环境。
essence: 专注于企业外部、通常不可控的宏观因素。帮助企业识别外部环境中的潜在机遇和威胁，驱动决策和风险管理。

scenarios.title: 战略规划
scenarios.text: 跨国公司进入新兴市场时，进行PESTLE分析，评估当地政治稳定性、经济发展水平、社会文化等。

scenarios.title: 新产品发布
scenarios.text: 食品公司推出植物基产品，通过PESTLE分析研究消费者对健康和可持续性的社会趋势、相关法规等。

scenarios.title: 风险管理
scenarios.text: 能源公司投资可再生能源项目前，进行PESTLE分析，评估政府补贴政策、能源价格波动、环保意识等。

pros: 提供对外部因素的全面审视。
帮助制定适应性强的战略。
有助于识别并减轻风险。
有助于发现新的市场机遇。
cons: 分析可能复杂且耗时。
因素解释可能主观，导致偏差。
仅关注外部因素，忽略内部优劣势。
属于资源密集型工作。
analysis: “宏观视角”是企业“预见未来”和“规避系统性风险”的基础。其“主观性”强调了“多源信息交叉验证”的重要性。与SWOT分析的“互补性”揭示了“内外结合”的战略分析范式。
definition_en: Assessing the external macro-environmental factors that affect a business: Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Legal, and Environmental.
essence_en: It focuses on macro factors external to the business that are usually uncontrollable. It helps companies identify potential opportunities and threats in the external environment, driving decision-making and risk management.

scenarios_en.title: Strategic Planning
scenarios_en.text: When entering an emerging market, a multinational company conducts a PESTLE analysis to assess local political stability, level of economic development, society and culture, and so on.

scenarios_en.title: New Product Launch
scenarios_en.text: A food company launching plant-based products uses PESTLE analysis to study social trends in consumer attitudes toward health and sustainability, relevant regulations, and so on.

scenarios_en.title: Risk Management
scenarios_en.text: Before investing in a renewable energy project, an energy company conducts a PESTLE analysis to assess government subsidy policies, energy price fluctuations, environmental awareness, and so on.

pros_en: It provides a comprehensive review of external factors.
It helps develop highly adaptable strategies.
It helps identify and mitigate risks.
It helps discover new market opportunities.
cons_en: The analysis can be complex and time-consuming.
Interpretation of factors may be subjective, leading to bias.
It focuses only on external factors and ignores internal strengths and weaknesses.
It is resource-intensive work.
analysis_en: A macro perspective is the foundation for a business to foresee the future and avoid systemic risks. Its subjectivity emphasizes the importance of cross-validating information from multiple sources. Its complementarity with SWOT analysis reveals a strategic analysis paradigm that combines internal and external perspectives.

name: BCG 矩阵
definition: 根据市场份额和市场增长率，将产品组合分为四类（明星、现金牛、问号、瘦狗），指导资源分配。
essence: 基于“市场增长率”和“相对市场份额”进行双维度分析。通过对产品进行分类，指导企业决定投资、维持、发展或剥离。

scenarios.title: 产品组合管理
scenarios.text: 苹果公司将iPhone视为“明星”，MacBook视为“现金牛”，iPod视为“瘦狗”，指导不同产品的投资策略。

scenarios.title: 战略投资决策
scenarios.text: 某大型集团评估旗下子公司，通过BCG矩阵识别哪些是现金牛、明星、问号和瘦狗，以指导投资。

scenarios.title: 资源优化
scenarios.text: 汽车制造商将传统燃油车业务视为“现金牛”，将电动汽车平台视为“问号”，并投入大量资源力求将其转变为“明星”。

pros: 概念清晰易懂，便于沟通。
帮助高效评估现有机会并制定优化策略。
提供资源分配指导，最大化未来增长。
cons: 未直接反映产品的盈利能力。
市场定义可能不清晰，导致过于简化。
可能忽略“瘦狗”产品的协同贡献。
是特定时间点的快照，具有静态性。
对小众高增长市场的产品可能分类不准。
analysis: “现金牛”概念揭示了成熟业务在“新业务孵化”中的关键作用。对“瘦狗”的建议（剥离）与“协同效应”之间存在张力，提示管理者需进行“全面价值评估”。“市场定义”的模糊性，强调了“情境化分析”的重要性。
definition_en: Classifying a product portfolio into four categories (Stars, Cash Cows, Question Marks, and Dogs) based on market share and market growth rate, to guide resource allocation.
essence_en: It is based on a two-dimensional analysis of market growth rate and relative market share. By classifying products, it guides companies in deciding whether to invest, maintain, develop, or divest.

scenarios_en.title: Product Portfolio Management
scenarios_en.text: Apple treats the iPhone as a Star, the MacBook as a Cash Cow, and the iPod as a Dog, guiding investment strategies for different products.

scenarios_en.title: Strategic Investment Decision
scenarios_en.text: A large conglomerate evaluates its subsidiaries and uses the BCG Matrix to identify which are Cash Cows, Stars, Question Marks, and Dogs, in order to guide investment.

scenarios_en.title: Resource Optimization
scenarios_en.text: An automaker treats its traditional internal combustion vehicle business as a Cash Cow and its electric vehicle platform as a Question Mark, and invests substantial resources in an effort to turn it into a Star.

pros_en: The concept is clear and easy to understand, making it easy to communicate.
It helps efficiently evaluate existing opportunities and develop optimization strategies.
It provides guidance on resource allocation to maximize future growth.
cons_en: It does not directly reflect a product's profitability.
Market definitions may be unclear, leading to oversimplification.
It may ignore the synergistic contribution of Dog products.
It is a snapshot at a specific point in time and is static in nature.
It may misclassify products in niche, high-growth markets.
analysis_en: The Cash Cow concept reveals the key role of mature businesses in incubating new businesses. There is tension between the recommendation for Dogs (divest) and synergy effects, suggesting managers need to carry out a comprehensive value assessment. The ambiguity of market definition emphasizes the importance of contextual analysis.

name: 艾森豪威尔矩阵
definition: 通过区分任务的紧急性（Urgency）和重要性（Importance）来组织和优先处理任务。
essence: 区分“紧急性 vs. 重要性”，将任务分为四象限：立即做（紧急重要）、计划做（重要不紧急）、委派（紧急不重要）、删除（不紧急不重要）。

scenarios.title: 个人时间管理
scenarios.text: 经理将客户提案列为“立即做”，战略规划列为“计划做”，回复非关键邮件“委派”，浏览社交媒体“删除”。

scenarios.title: 团队工作分配
scenarios.text: 团队领导将核心开发任务分配给资深工程师（立即做），市场调研安排在后期（计划做），数据录入委派给实习生（委派）。

scenarios.title: 提高生产力
scenarios.text: CEO将融资路演准备放在首位（立即做），产品路线图规划每周固定时间（计划做），日常行政事务交给行政（委派）。

pros: 提供清晰优先级。
引导用户聚焦最重要任务，提高生产力。
及时处理紧急重要任务可减轻压力。
提供结构化方法管理任务。
促进委派和消除干扰。
cons: 初步分类时可能难以准确区分紧急性和重要性。
可能将重要任务误判为不重要而委派。
对动态变化的任务可能不够灵活。
analysis: 核心价值在于“反直觉的优先级排序”——即关注重要但不紧急的任务，是提升长期生产力的关键。“委派”象限强调了“领导力与团队发展”的结合。“删除”象限是管理者“聚焦核心价值”的强力提醒。
definition_en: Organizing and prioritizing tasks by distinguishing between their Urgency and Importance.
essence_en: It distinguishes urgency vs. importance and divides tasks into four quadrants: Do (urgent and important), Schedule (important but not urgent), Delegate (urgent but not important), and Delete (neither urgent nor important).

scenarios_en.title: Personal Time Management
scenarios_en.text: A manager lists a client proposal as Do, strategic planning as Schedule, replying to non-critical emails as Delegate, and browsing social media as Delete.

scenarios_en.title: Team Work Allocation
scenarios_en.text: A team leader assigns core development tasks to senior engineers (Do), schedules market research for later (Schedule), and delegates data entry to interns (Delegate).

scenarios_en.title: Improving Productivity
scenarios_en.text: A CEO puts preparation for a fundraising roadshow first (Do), sets aside a fixed time each week for product roadmap planning (Schedule), and hands routine administrative work to an assistant (Delegate).

pros_en: It provides clear priorities.
It guides users to focus on the most important tasks and improves productivity.
Handling urgent and important tasks promptly can reduce stress.
It provides a structured method for managing tasks.
It promotes delegation and the elimination of distractions.
cons_en: During initial classification, it may be difficult to accurately distinguish urgency from importance.
Important tasks may be misjudged as unimportant and delegated.
It may not be flexible enough for dynamically changing tasks.
analysis_en: Its core value lies in its counterintuitive prioritization - namely, focusing on important but not urgent tasks, which is key to improving long-term productivity. The Delegate quadrant emphasizes the combination of leadership and team development. The Delete quadrant is a powerful reminder for managers to focus on core value.

name: 5 Whys 方法
definition: 通过反复询问“为什么”（通常是五次）来深入挖掘问题的根本原因。
essence: 核心原则是“迭代追问”，直到找到深层根源，而非停留在表面症状。简单易行，最适用于具有单一根因的问题。

scenarios.title: 简单问题解决
scenarios.text: 生产线上机器停止，通过5次追问发现根本原因是“维护计划执行不力”。

scenarios.title: 质量控制
scenarios.text: 客户投诉产品划痕，追问发现根本原因是“市场竞争导致成本控制过度，影响质量”。

scenarios.title: 流程改进
scenarios.text: 员工抱怨审批流程慢，追问发现根本原因是“审批流程设计过于集中，未能适应业务发展”。

pros: 简单易学，无需专业培训。
几乎零成本。
鼓励深入思考，发现表面之下的问题。
促进团队协作和对问题的共同理解。
cons: 不适用于具有多个根本原因的复杂问题。
如果追问不够深入，可能停留在表面。
结果质量依赖于提问者的经验。
如果团队氛围不佳，可能演变为互相指责。
analysis: “反复追问”原则是培养团队“批判性思维”和“系统性思考”的有效训练。“单一根因”的局限性，暗示了其需要与其他多因分析工具（如鱼骨图）结合使用。“无责备环境”的要求，揭示了组织文化对工具有效性的影响。
definition_en: Digging deep into the root cause of a problem by repeatedly asking why (usually five times).
essence_en: Its core principle is iterative questioning, until the deep root cause is found rather than stopping at surface symptoms. It is simple and easy to carry out, and is best suited to problems with a single root cause.

scenarios_en.title: Simple Problem Solving
scenarios_en.text: A machine on a production line stops, and through five rounds of questioning the root cause is found to be poor execution of the maintenance plan.

scenarios_en.title: Quality Control
scenarios_en.text: A customer complains about scratches on a product, and questioning reveals the root cause to be excessive cost control driven by market competition, affecting quality.

scenarios_en.title: Process Improvement
scenarios_en.text: Employees complain that the approval process is slow, and questioning reveals the root cause to be an approval process design that is overly centralized and has failed to adapt to business growth.

pros_en: It is simple and easy to learn, requiring no specialist training.
It costs almost nothing.
It encourages deep thinking and uncovers problems beneath the surface.
It promotes team collaboration and a shared understanding of the problem.
cons_en: It is not suitable for complex problems with multiple root causes.
If questioning is not deep enough, it may stop at the surface.
The quality of the results depends on the questioner's experience.
If the team atmosphere is poor, it may turn into mutual blame.
analysis_en: The principle of repeated questioning is effective training for cultivating critical thinking and systems thinking in a team. Its single-root-cause limitation suggests it needs to be used together with multi-cause analysis tools (such as fishbone diagrams). Its requirement for a blame-free environment reveals the influence of organizational culture on a tool's effectiveness.

name: 鱼骨图
definition: 一种可视化工具，用于识别问题的可能原因，并将其分类以揭示根本原因。
essence: 结构特点是“问题居中”（鱼头），通过“主要类别”（大骨，如6M）和“次要原因”（小骨）来系统化探索原因。常与5 Whys结合使用。

scenarios.title: 根本原因分析
scenarios.text: 公司客户满意度下降，用鱼骨图从“人员”、“流程”、“设备”等维度深入挖掘具体原因。

scenarios.title: 质量改进
scenarios.text: 汽车制造厂发现车辆油漆缺陷，从“材料”、“机器”、“方法”、“人员”等角度查找原因。

scenarios.title: 流程优化
scenarios.text: 医院患者等待时间过长，从“人员”、“方法”、“设备”、“环境”等多个方面寻找改进点。

pros: 结构化和可视化，将复杂问题分解为可管理部分。
促进团队协作，汇集集体智慧。
帮助识别所有潜在原因，确保全面性。
有助于团队达成共识。
cons: 如果原因过多，图表可能变得过于复杂。
如果团队未能深入挖掘，可能停留在表面。
仅用于识别原因，不直接提供解决方案。
analysis: 能将头脑风暴中看似随机的想法组织成逻辑清晰的类别，将混乱转化为清晰。通过提供共享的视觉框架促进集体理解。为避免分析流于形式，应鼓励结合5 Whys等更深入的追问技术。
definition_en: A visualization tool used to identify the possible causes of a problem and classify them in order to reveal the root cause.
essence_en: Its structure places the problem in the center (the fish head), and systematically explores causes through main categories (the large bones, such as the 6Ms) and secondary causes (the small bones). It is often used together with the 5 Whys.

scenarios_en.title: Root Cause Analysis
scenarios_en.text: A company's customer satisfaction declines, and a fishbone diagram is used to dig into specific causes across dimensions such as People, Process, and Equipment.

scenarios_en.title: Quality Improvement
scenarios_en.text: A car factory discovers paint defects on vehicles and looks for causes from the angles of Materials, Machines, Methods, and People.

scenarios_en.title: Process Optimization
scenarios_en.text: Patients at a hospital wait too long, and improvement points are sought across multiple aspects such as People, Methods, Equipment, and Environment.

pros_en: It is structured and visual, breaking a complex problem down into manageable parts.
It promotes team collaboration and pools collective wisdom.
It helps identify all potential causes, ensuring comprehensiveness.
It helps the team reach consensus.
cons_en: If there are too many causes, the diagram can become overly complex.
If the team fails to dig deep, it may stop at the surface.
It is only used to identify causes and does not directly provide solutions.
analysis_en: It can organize seemingly random ideas from brainstorming into logically clear categories, turning confusion into clarity. By providing a shared visual framework, it promotes collective understanding. To avoid the analysis becoming a mere formality, deeper questioning techniques such as the 5 Whys should be encouraged in combination.

name: 场力分析
definition: 通过识别和分析推动变革的“驱动力”和阻碍变革的“阻碍力”，来帮助理解变革的动态。
essence: 核心概念是“驱动力”和“阻碍力”之间的平衡。当前状态是两力平衡的结果，变革需通过增强驱动力或削弱阻碍力来实现。通常涉及对力量进行评分和加权。

scenarios.title: 变革管理
scenarios.text: 公司实施数字转型，识别驱动力（管理层支持）和阻碍力（员工抵触），并制定沟通和培训计划以应对。

scenarios.title: 战略规划
scenarios.text: 企业考虑进入新国际市场，评估驱动力（市场潜力）和阻碍力（文化差异、法规壁垒），以决定是否及如何进入。

scenarios.title: 风险评估
scenarios.text: 项目经理启动高风险项目前，识别驱动力（技术成熟度）和阻碍力（预算限制），制定风险缓解措施。

pros: 提供结构化方法识别和可视化驱动力与阻碍力。
帮助评估变革的可行性。
能制定有针对性的策略来克服阻力。
增强决策的清晰度。
cons: 对力量评分可能存在主观性。
可能过度简化复杂问题。
主要关注当前力量，而非长期影响。
在大型组织中可能无法捕捉所有因素。
analysis: 通过可视化力量，帮助管理者识别阻力点并有效利用支持。它强调平衡积极力量与阻力，确保更顺利的变革。其主观性表明它更适合作为讨论启动工具，而非精确定量算法。
definition_en: Helping to understand the dynamics of change by identifying and analyzing the driving forces that push change forward and the restraining forces that hinder it.
essence_en: Its core concept is the balance between driving forces and restraining forces. The current state is the result of the two forces being in balance, and change must be achieved by strengthening driving forces or weakening restraining forces. It usually involves scoring and weighting the forces.

scenarios_en.title: Change Management
scenarios_en.text: A company implements a digital transformation, identifies driving forces (management support) and restraining forces (employee resistance), and develops communication and training plans to address them.

scenarios_en.title: Strategic Planning
scenarios_en.text: A business considers entering a new international market and evaluates driving forces (market potential) and restraining forces (cultural differences, regulatory barriers) to decide whether and how to enter.

scenarios_en.title: Risk Assessment
scenarios_en.text: Before launching a high-risk project, a project manager identifies driving forces (technological maturity) and restraining forces (budget constraints) and develops risk mitigation measures.

pros_en: It provides a structured method for identifying and visualizing driving and restraining forces.
It helps assess the feasibility of change.
It allows targeted strategies to be developed to overcome resistance.
It enhances clarity in decision-making.
cons_en: Scoring the forces may involve subjectivity.
It may oversimplify complex problems.
It focuses mainly on current forces rather than long-term impacts.
In large organizations, it may not capture all factors.
analysis_en: By visualizing the forces, it helps managers identify points of resistance and effectively leverage support. It emphasizes balancing positive forces against resistance to ensure smoother change. Its subjectivity indicates it is better suited as a tool for starting discussion than as a precise quantitative algorithm.

name: 情景规划
definition: 通过想象不同的未来可能性（包括有利和不利情景），为可能发生的事情做好准备。
essence: 核心原则是“识别关键触发因素”，“创建多个情景”（最佳、最差、最可能），并“制定灵活的响应策略”。

scenarios.title: 长期战略制定
scenarios.text: 能源公司面对能源转型的不确定性，制定了快速脱碳、缓慢转型和技术停滞三种未来情景，并为每种情景制定相应战略。

scenarios.title: 风险管理与韧性建设
scenarios.text: 全球供应链企业评估不同供应链中断情景的影响，并制定了多元化采购和区域化生产的应急预案。

scenarios.title: 创新与新业务探索
scenarios.text: 金融科技公司评估未来监管、消费者偏好和竞争格局的不同演变，从而设计出更具适应性的产品路线图。

pros: 帮助做出更明智、更具战略性的决策。
增强风险管理，提高组织韧性。
建立灵活的战略，提高适应性。
抓住新机遇。
cons: 是资源密集型工作，耗时耗力。
涉及不确定性，可能无法提供明确答案。
基于假设，如果假设不准确可能导致错误战略。
可能过度关注短期情景，忽视长期趋势。
analysis: 通过创建多个情景，帮助企业构建组织韧性，培养适应性。其“长期战略”聚焦，突显了其在应对系统性变革中的作用。“资源密集”和“持续更新”的特性，强调了它是一个活态过程，而非一次性任务。
definition_en: Preparing for what may happen by imagining different future possibilities (including favorable and unfavorable scenarios).
essence_en: Its core principles are to identify key triggers, create multiple scenarios (best, worst, and most likely), and develop flexible response strategies.

scenarios_en.title: Long-Term Strategy Formulation
scenarios_en.text: Faced with uncertainty in the energy transition, an energy company develops three future scenarios - rapid decarbonization, slow transition, and technological stagnation - and develops a corresponding strategy for each.

scenarios_en.title: Risk Management and Resilience Building
scenarios_en.text: A global supply chain company assesses the impact of different supply chain disruption scenarios and develops contingency plans for diversified sourcing and regionalized production.

scenarios_en.title: Innovation and New Business Exploration
scenarios_en.text: A fintech company assesses different evolutions in regulation, consumer preferences, and the competitive landscape, in order to design a more adaptable product roadmap.

pros_en: It helps make wiser, more strategic decisions.
It strengthens risk management and improves organizational resilience.
It builds flexible strategies and improves adaptability.
It allows new opportunities to be seized.
cons_en: It is resource-intensive work, consuming time and effort.
It involves uncertainty and may not provide clear answers.
It is based on assumptions, and if the assumptions are inaccurate it may lead to the wrong strategy.
It may overfocus on short-term scenarios and ignore long-term trends.
analysis_en: By creating multiple scenarios, it helps companies build organizational resilience and cultivate adaptability. Its focus on long-term strategy highlights its role in responding to systemic change. Its resource-intensive nature and need for continuous updating emphasize that it is a living process, not a one-off task.

name: 风险管理矩阵
definition: 通过评估风险事件发生的可能性和潜在影响，来帮助企业优先处理风险。
essence: 基于“可能性”和“潜在影响”两个交叉因素评估风险。通过颜色编码（红、黄、绿）呈现风险严重性，以“优先处理风险”。

scenarios.title: 项目风险管理
scenarios.text: 项目经理评估代码bug的可能性（高）和影响（中），以及关键开发人员离职的可能性（低）和影响（高），从而优先制定应对计划。

scenarios.title: 企业风险管理
scenarios.text: 金融机构评估网络安全漏洞（高可能性、高影响）、市场波动（中可能性、中影响）等，制定全面的风险应对策略。

scenarios.title: 决策支持
scenarios.text: 董事会评估重大投资时，使用风险矩阵评估回报不确定性、市场竞争加剧等风险，做出更审慎的决策。

pros: 以简化的视觉方式呈现复杂数据。
提高风险优先级划分的透明度。
适用于大型复杂系统和单个流程。
能有效向非技术受众沟通风险。
为风险讨论创造共同切入点。
cons: 需要精确定义主题范围。
可能掩盖估计中的置信度差异。
可能过度简化风险的复杂性。
可能为主观评估赋予科学精确性的假象。
不测量预期货币损失，也无法建议投入多少。
analysis: “可视化优先级”是其关键优势，能快速识别关键威胁并高效分配资源。它能促进跨部门和层级的有效沟通。其“主观性评分”和“过度简化”的局限性，提示管理者应将其视为支持决策的工具，而非机械算法。
definition_en: Helping companies prioritize risks by assessing the likelihood of a risk event occurring and its potential impact.
essence_en: It assesses risk based on two intersecting factors: likelihood and potential impact. Risk severity is presented through color coding (red, yellow, green) in order to prioritize risks.

scenarios_en.title: Project Risk Management
scenarios_en.text: A project manager assesses the likelihood (high) and impact (medium) of code bugs, and the likelihood (low) and impact (high) of a key developer leaving, and therefore prioritizes response plans.

scenarios_en.title: Enterprise Risk Management
scenarios_en.text: A financial institution assesses cybersecurity vulnerabilities (high likelihood, high impact), market volatility (medium likelihood, medium impact), and so on, and develops a comprehensive risk response strategy.

scenarios_en.title: Decision Support
scenarios_en.text: When the board assesses a major investment, it uses a risk matrix to assess risks such as return uncertainty and intensifying market competition, and makes a more prudent decision.

pros_en: It presents complex data in a simplified visual way.
It improves transparency in risk prioritization.
It is applicable to large, complex systems and to individual processes.
It can effectively communicate risk to non-technical audiences.
It creates a common entry point for risk discussions.
cons_en: The scope of the topic needs to be precisely defined.
It may mask differences in confidence in the estimates.
It may oversimplify the complexity of risk.
It may give subjective assessments a false impression of scientific precision.
It does not measure expected monetary loss, nor can it advise how much to invest.
analysis_en: Visual prioritization is its key advantage, allowing critical threats to be identified quickly and resources to be allocated efficiently. It can promote effective communication across departments and levels. Its limitations of subjective scoring and oversimplification suggest managers should treat it as a tool to support decisions, rather than a mechanical algorithm.

name: 博弈论
definition: 研究理性决策者之间在竞争或合作情景下的战略互动，并预测其最可能的结果。
essence: 核心是解释两个或更多“玩家”的战略行动，一个玩家的收益取决于其他玩家的策略。假设玩家是理性的并追求收益最大化。

scenarios.title: 商业竞争与定价
scenarios.text: 两家电信公司在推出新套餐时，利用博弈论分析彼此可能的定价和营销策略，以预测市场份额和利润。

scenarios.title: 谈判与冲突解决
scenarios.text: 在劳资谈判中，工会和资方可以运用博弈论分析彼此的底线和策略，以达成对双方最有利的协议。

scenarios.title: 资源分配
scenarios.text: 政府在分配稀缺的医疗资源时，可以运用博弈论考虑不同利益相关者的需求和行为，以实现社会效益最大化。

pros: 为分析战略互动提供结构化框架。
有助于预测竞争情景下最可能的结果。
广泛适用于多个学科。
cons: “理性人”假设可能不完全符合现实。
难以解释忠诚、诚实或同情等行为。
在复杂情景下可能无法准确预测。
假设信息完全且无沟通。
对大量玩家或复杂策略的分析可能非常复杂。
analysis: 对“理性假设”的依赖是其基础也是局限，管理者需结合对实际行为的理解进行修正。通过建模相互依赖的收益，帮助管理者预测竞争对手的行动。在处理复杂情况时，需要简化模型或进行定性解释。
definition_en: Studying strategic interaction between rational decision-makers in competitive or cooperative situations, and predicting the most likely outcomes.
essence_en: Its core is to explain the strategic actions of two or more players, where one player's payoff depends on the strategies of the other players. It assumes players are rational and seek to maximize their payoff.

scenarios_en.title: Business Competition and Pricing
scenarios_en.text: When launching new packages, two telecommunications companies use game theory to analyze each other's possible pricing and marketing strategies, in order to predict market share and profit.

scenarios_en.title: Negotiation and Conflict Resolution
scenarios_en.text: In labor negotiations, a union and management can use game theory to analyze each other's bottom lines and strategies, in order to reach an agreement most beneficial to both sides.

scenarios_en.title: Resource Allocation
scenarios_en.text: When allocating scarce medical resources, a government can use game theory to consider the needs and behavior of different stakeholders, in order to maximize social benefit.

pros_en: It provides a structured framework for analyzing strategic interaction.
It helps predict the most likely outcomes in competitive situations.
It is widely applicable across multiple disciplines.
cons_en: The rational person assumption may not fully match reality.
It has difficulty explaining behavior such as loyalty, honesty, or sympathy.
In complex situations, it may not be able to predict accurately.
It assumes complete information and no communication.
Analysis with a large number of players or complex strategies can be very complex.
analysis_en: Its reliance on the rationality assumption is both its foundation and its limitation, and managers need to correct for it by combining it with an understanding of actual behavior. By modeling interdependent payoffs, it helps managers predict competitors' actions. When dealing with complex situations, the model needs to be simplified or interpreted qualitatively.

name: 名义小组技术 (NGT)
definition: 一种结构化的群体决策方法，鼓励所有成员平等参与，并快速达成共识。
essence: 核心是“沉默生成想法”、“轮流分享”、“讨论澄清”和“投票排序”的结构化流程。旨在避免个人主导，确保所有声音都被听到。

scenarios.title: 问题识别与解决
scenarios.text: 公司面临员工敬业度下降，使用NGT让员工匿名写下原因和解决方案，通过投票识别核心问题和方案。

scenarios.title: 决策与优先级排序
scenarios.text: 非营利组织通过NGT让利益相关者评估多个社区服务项目在社会影响、成本效益等方面的表现，并投票决定。

scenarios.title: 寻求多元意见
scenarios.text: 城市规划部门邀请市民、商家等不同群体代表参与NGT，收集他们对新交通政策的看法和建议。

pros: 提供结构化框架，确保系统化决策。
鼓励所有成员平等参与。
能产生大量想法，并避免个人主导。
促进团队达成共识，并提供量化输出。
cons: 严格流程可能限制自发性和创造性。
可能不适用于需要深入分析的复杂问题。
投票过程可能过度简化决策。
讨论时间有限，可能探索不充分。
准备活动可能耗时。
analysis: “沉默生成”和“轮流分享”机制是防止强势个体主导讨论的关键。它是一种高效的决策工具，能在较短时间内从大量想法中筛选出最有价值的选项。其“僵化性”和“分析不完整”的局限性，提示管理者需权衡其与问题复杂度的匹配。
definition_en: A structured group decision-making method that encourages all members to participate equally and reach consensus quickly.
essence_en: Its core is a structured process of silently generating ideas, sharing in turn, discussing for clarification, and voting to rank. It aims to avoid domination by individuals and ensure all voices are heard.

scenarios_en.title: Problem Identification and Solving
scenarios_en.text: Faced with declining employee engagement, a company uses NGT to have employees anonymously write down causes and solutions, and identifies the core problems and solutions through voting.

scenarios_en.title: Decision-Making and Prioritization
scenarios_en.text: A non-profit organization uses NGT to have stakeholders evaluate multiple community service projects on social impact, cost-effectiveness, and other aspects, and votes to decide.

scenarios_en.title: Seeking Diverse Opinions
scenarios_en.text: A city planning department invites representatives of different groups, such as residents and businesses, to participate in NGT and gather their views and suggestions on a new transport policy.

pros_en: It provides a structured framework, ensuring systematic decision-making.
It encourages all members to participate equally.
It can generate a large number of ideas and avoid domination by individuals.
It promotes team consensus and provides quantitative output.
cons_en: A strict process may limit spontaneity and creativity.
It may not be suitable for complex problems requiring in-depth analysis.
The voting process may oversimplify decisions.
Discussion time is limited and exploration may be insufficient.
Preparing the activities can be time-consuming.
analysis_en: The mechanisms of silent generation and sharing in turn are key to preventing dominant individuals from taking over the discussion. It is an efficient decision-making tool that can filter the most valuable options from a large number of ideas in a relatively short time. Its limitations of rigidity and incomplete analysis suggest managers need to weigh how well it matches the complexity of the problem.
